units.source_text: 不知怎的，我心绪烦乱，凝望着老师的影子的时候，我险些遭到感动的侵袭，这是事实。

en.t: For some reason, my heart was disturbed, and as I gazed at the teacher's shadow, I nearly found myself overwhelmed by emotion; that is the truth.

units.source_text: 我虽然竭力否认，但我确实要来到爱慕老师的交界线了。

en.t: Though I tried with all my might to deny it, I had in fact come to the borderline of admiring the teacher.

units.source_text: 多亏我想到"分明是做给我看的"。

en.t: I was saved by the thought, "Clearly, he did it for me to see."

units.source_text: 一切都在逆转，我把比先前更加坚定的心据为己有了。

en.t: Everything was being reversed, and I took possession of a heart even firmer than before.
